entities.summary: Siad Barre, a notable figure in the history of Somalia, associated with Independence and Somali Republic (1969–1991). Preceded by Siad Barre Military Regime and Independence and Unification. Their legacy influenced Ogaden War with Ethiopia and Civil War and State Collapse.
